day_07_morning: ^There is a place beneath Saint Orra where the Bell cannot be heard.
^Vey keeps it. They are old, and patient, and they do not cast a shadow.
^You are the Bellkeeper, Vey says. You look like someone who has been carrying a city uphill.
^People come here to forget, they say. Not everything. Just the parts that will not stop hurting.
^Mara's hand is not on her hammer. Iven is looking at the door. Wren is looking at you.
^The Bell cannot reach this room, Vey says. Stay. Let the city have one quiet day.
^Refuse. The city cannot forget its way out of this.
accept: ^You sit. The chair is warm. The quiet is so complete that you can hear your own heart deciding to slow down.
^One day, Vey says. That is all I ask.
ask: ^Nothing you will miss, Vey says. That is the cost.
^Toma writes it down. Wren takes the pen away from him.
refuse: ^Then you will meet the Saint, Vey says. They do not sound angry. They sound tired.
^Mara picks up her hammer. Good, she says. I was starting to like the quiet too much.
day_07_afternoon: ^Vey leads you to the inner door. Beyond it, the sanctuary's guardian waits in a field of ash.
^The Saint of Ash is what the sanctuary does with the memories it cannot keep.
^Accept my offer, Vey says, and you will never have to fight it. Refuse, and it will fight for the city's forgetting.
^The door is open. The ash is warm under your feet.
^Accept Vey's mercy. Let the Saint sleep.
mercy: ^You step back from the door. Vey closes it without a sound.
^For one day, the Bell is only a sound in another room.
^Mara sits down. Iven does not. Wren watches the door.
fight: ^You step into the ash. The Saint rises. Somewhere behind you, Vey does not move.
^The Bell in your chest rings once, clear and bright and terrible.
^Then we remember, you say. Even this.
night_mercy: ^The day passes without a Bell. No one fights. No one dies. It is the kindest day you can remember.
^That is the problem. You cannot remember why you came.
^Mara is laughing at something Toma said. Iven is asleep in a chair. Wren is drawing the ceiling.
^Vey stands beside you. One day is almost over, they say. You may keep it. Or you may keep the reason you came.
^Keep the memory of this quiet day.
^Keep the reason. Take the day back.
night_fight: ^The Saint of Ash comes apart into a hundred memories. None of them are yours.
^Vey watches from the doorway. You have made the sanctuary smaller, they say. And the city larger.
^Mara is bleeding. Iven is steady. Wren is already writing down what happened.
^Ask Wren to write it all down.
keep_day: ^You keep the quiet. The reason fades like a word held too long.
^It is enough. It has to be.
keep_reason: ^You take the reason back. It hurts immediately.
^Good, Mara says. That means it is yours.
both: ^Vey is silent for a long time. Then they smile, and it is the first honest thing you have seen them do.
^No one has asked for both before, they say. I do not know if I can give it.
keep_fight: ^You keep the fight. The ash, the noise, the moment the Saint came apart.
^Mara takes your hand. You do not let go until the Bell rings.
give_ash: ^Vey takes the ash. The sanctuary grows a little larger. The city forgets a little more.
^You tell yourself it is a fair trade. You are not sure who you are telling.
record: ^Wren writes it all down. Every page. Every name.
^When she is finished, she reads it back to you. You only have to remember once.
